prompt: I'm building an order processing system in Go. Orders are produced by a web API and need to be processed by exactly one of several worker instances, with retries on failure. Show me how to model the stream and consumer in JetStream and write the producer plus a worker.

assertions.text: Publisher sets Nats-Msg-Id for idempotent/dedup publish
Uses a durable PULL consumer (not push/ephemeral)
